title: Chunu and Munu: The Corn Is Yummy!
summary: Chunu and Munu help their father grow corn in the field. Will they get to taste it too?
pages: Chunu and Munu are walking. They come to the cornfield.
Their father is in the field. He is planting corn.
"Can we help you?" the girls ask.
Father looks at Chunu. Then he looks at Munu.
"All right," says Father. "Come and help me."
Chunu and Munu are happy. They water the corn.
After a few weeks, the corn begins to sprout. The girls cheer and smile.
They pull out the weeds around the corn. It is growing so nicely!

A few weeks later... Chunu says, "Look at all the weeds!"
Munu says, "Look at all the grass."
Chunu pulls out the weeds. Munu pulls out the grass.
The corn in the field is happy.
Chunu picks the ears of corn. Munu puts them in the basket.
The basket is full of corn! The girls carry it all the way home.
Father roasts the corn. Chunu and Munu eat it happily.
Chunu and Munu shout happily, "The corn is yummy. Really yummy!"
